etymology.historical_story: Saamiya is attested as a personal name in the producer's account of Veer-Zaara, released in 2004. Saamiya Siddiqui is the Pakistani lawyer who investigates Veer's story and seeks justice for him. This documents a cultural use of the spelling, but it does not establish the name's linguistic origin or a Malay dictionary meaning. [Producer's synopsis](https://www.yashrajfilms.com/movies/veer-zaara)
